mapper.insert: insert into chat_sessions (id, user_id, status, title) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{title})
insert into diary_conversations (session_id, round, speaker, content) values (#{sessionId}, #{round}, #{speaker}, #{content})
insert into diary_conversations (session_id, content, round, speaker) values (#{sessionId}, #{content}, #{round}, #{speaker})
mapper.update: update chat_sessions set raw_facts = #{newRawFacts}, raw_facts_last_round = #{round}, raw_facts_pending_round = null where id = #{sessionId} and raw_facts_pending_round = #{round}

update chat_sessions
title = #{dto.title},
raw_facts = #{dto.rawFacts},
updated_at = now()
where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from chat_sessions where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId}
update chat_sessions set last_round = last_round + 1, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} RETURNING last_round
select raw_facts from chat_sessions where id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId}
select raw_facts as rawFacts, raw_facts_last_round as rawFactsLastRound from chat_sessions where id = #{sessionId}
select round, speaker, content from diary_conversations where session_id = #{sessionId} and round > #{diff}
select id, title, status, version_group, started_at, updated_at, finished_at from chat_sessions where user_id = #{userId} and last_round > 0 order by updated_at desc
